A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain complete main text and Appendices A–C. Equations, tables, figures and experiments can be matched despite subsection reordering and model-identification corrections.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original adapter-training experiments, including classification, structure-preservation measurements, collision rates and MNIST dimensionality-reduction visualizations.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain original classification, structure-preservation, collision-rate and dimensionality-reduction results produced by the work.

M1.justification: The augmented-encoder procedure, MaWa and WaCo objectives, frozen-backbone adapters and dimensionality-reduction option remain unchanged. Model-identification and mathematical corrections do not establish a change to the implemented training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use STL10, TinyImageNet, its 50-class subset and MNIST, retaining the same rotation, affine, noise and crop scenarios. No dataset or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: The evaluated alternatives remain SimCLR/SCLR, HSIC maximization and the end-to-end classifier without an adapter. Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main-text and appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 revises the stated pretraining objective for DINO and R-DINO from DINOv2 to DINO while retaining checkpoint identifiers. Equation 35 explicitly excludes self-pairs from Lipschitz comparisons. These are corrections to the reported setup; the PDFs do not establish experimental reruns.

E4.justification: Dimensionality-reduction comparisons, structure-preservation diagnostics, raw versus aligned collision analyses and MNIST/t-SNE case studies are retained. No new ablation, robustness test or supplementary analysis is introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point estimates and descriptive structure statistics. Neither introduces repeated-run or seed counts, uncertainty intervals, error bars or significance testing for the experiments.

E6.justification: Section 4.2.1 corrects the prose EC noise accuracy from 58.29% to 58.22%, matching Table 1 in both versions. Numerical tables and figure data are unchanged; added CVRMSD mentions repeat existing table entries.

T1.justification: Appendix A, Equation 53 removes an extra inner 1/p exponent, making the quantile expression consistent with the sliced-Wasserstein definition. Equation 35 adds x≠y to the Lipschitz extrema. These are localized mathematical corrections; the theoretical framework and proofs are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract and Section 1.1 attribute the headline STL10 rotation and noise results to DINO rather than DINOv2. This corrects the model-specific scope of those claims; the central contributions concerning lightweight post-training invariance and structure preservation remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4.2.4 qualifies aligned collision rates as only roughly predicting MaWa feasibility. Section 5.2 removes the suggestion of adversarial robustness without adversarial training, retaining a more cautious future-work proposal. Existing limitations remain.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 changes repository references from DINOv2 to DINO for the retained dino_vits8 and dino_resnet50 identifiers. Appendix B adopts the corrected identification; architecture dimensions, hyperparameters, hardware, timing and augmentation details otherwise match.

R1.justification: The Oquab et al. (2023) DINOv2 reference is removed, while the existing Caron et al. (2021) DINO citation supports the revised model description. Broader related-work coverage and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The Markov-Wasserstein kernels and Wasserstein correlation background subsections swap order, with corresponding renumbering and cross-reference updates. Local grammatical, spelling and terminology edits refine the text without extensive rewriting.

P2.justification: Figures and tables are retained with unchanged plot images and table structures. Captions correct DINO terminology, Table 13 moves from page 47 to page 46 before Appendix C, and nearby text and equations reflow.

improvement.justification: v3 improves correctness and reproducibility through consistent DINO identification and repository references, the Equation 53 correction, explicit exclusion of self-pairs and agreement between noise-accuracy prose and Table 1. It also tempers speculative robustness language. These are useful but limited improvements; the method, experimental evidence and principal limitations remain unchanged.
